source_differences: Type: record note and operator call it a 'gondola', lift-world (75-AT), the 2006 list (N = nihalka) and RTV SLO ('nihalka') show it is a pendulum aerial tramway with 2 x 75-person cabins.
Length: operator 3265 m, lift-world 3263 m, 2006 list 3320 m.
Vertical: lift-world 914 m (but 1411-492 = 919 m), 2006 list 915 m, operator 'about 1000 m'.
Valley elevation: operator 490 m, lift-world 492 m, 2006 list 495 m.
Capacity: lift-world 350 p/h vs 2006 list 275 p/h. Travel time: lift-world 7 min vs operator/RTV ~8 min.

An earlier note on this record says both points are operator GPS, no GPS was found on the operator pages opened here (en.golte.si/panoramska-nihalka, /o-golteh). Valley point agrees with the hiking-trail car park (~60 m), top point not compared because the note's value isn't in the input record.
